title: 第2章 红影
content_zh:
机会，是需要自己去创造的。
李皓需要的契机，也需要自己去创造。
很快，李皓面前整理好了一份档案，起身，李皓朝办公区的小办公室走去。
“咚咚咚！”
李皓敲响了办公室大门。
门内传来机要室室长的声音：“进来！”
李皓推开办公室大门。
“室长！”
“李皓啊！”
人到中年的王杰，看到李皓，不由露出笑容。
这是一个懂礼貌，肯干活的好孩子，毕竟受过银城古院的高等教育，虽然提前退学了，可也不是被开除，而是自己退学，他还是很关注的。
李皓也露出笑容，很快开口道：“室长，我有事汇报。”
“坐吧！”
王杰招呼了一声，机要室的任务不算太繁重，至于事情，也没什么大事，大事一般也是前面的执法队去执行，总体来说，机要室还是很安稳的。
对于李皓来汇报工作，王杰猜想，是不是这小子想混个脸熟，让自己提拔提拔他？
可时间太短了，这家伙又退学了，才转正半年，短时间想提拔也不可能了。
正想着，面前的李皓面色开始严肃起来，声音显得有些沉闷：“室长，我在机要室，主要负责一些疑案、悬案的档案归整。进入机要室一年，我将最近十年的一些档案都进行了重新归整，重新分类……”
王杰瞬间露出笑容，点头道：“我知道，高材生就是高材生！以前档案还有些乱，一些老档案都快被虫蛀了，我也让人重新整理过，不过还是经常需要的时候找不到，你一来，最近想找什么案子，马上就能找到，这点你有功……”
李皓连忙摇头：“室长，我可不是来炫耀夸功的。”
不是吗？

王杰失笑，那难不成还真有事汇报？
他也没说什么，点点头，示意李皓继续说。
李皓取出面前的文件，递给了王杰一份，自己翻开一份，年纪虽轻，声音却是沉稳：“1720年，9月16日，银城安居小区发生一起自焚案，有人目睹受害人当众自焚，身体内部忽然冒出火花，活生生将当事人烧死。”
王杰此刻也看起了自己手中的档案，接着看向李皓。
十年前的案子了，而且已经结案了，不是被害，而是意外，这小子重提十年前已经结案的案子做什么？
李皓继续：“1723年，9月22日，银城商贸中心，一位售货员忽然头发着火，很快燃烧全身，当众被焚烧而死。”
王杰点点头，“这个我知道，当初就是我归档的，我还亲自去了现场，是意外，当时商贸中心的静电过大导致的。”
李皓也没辩驳，继续念了起来：“1725年，8月18日，银城民生酒店，一位住客在酒店内入住，一天后被人发现死于酒店内，也是自焚而死。”
距离第一起自焚案间隔五年，距离第二起间隔两年。
五年间，发生了三起自焚案，不过都是意外，银城每天都要处理许多案子，五年三起意外导致的自焚案，还真不是什么大事，也没几个人在意。
除非碰巧，三起案子都是一人经手，也许还能引起一些关注。
机要室档案无数，王杰平时也没在意，此刻听了几句，隐约有些感觉，皱眉看向李皓。
李皓继续道：“1727年，2月16日，银城东方大街，又有一人自焚而亡，原因是附近有球形闪电出现，疑似球形闪电导致，诱发人体自焚，时隔上一起自焚案，一年半！”
王杰面色微变，从三年到两年，两年到一年半，银城又发生了一起自焚案！
“1728年，8月12日，银城郊区巡检司上报，境内一人失踪，事后在河边发现一具被焚烧的尸骨，疑似雷雨天雷电击中导致，以意外结案。”
又是一年半！
这是下属机构上报上来的，机要室只是做档案归整，并不参与案件处理，何况这种意外引发的案子，下面已经结案了，上面也不会贸然去推翻。
王杰面色越来越凝重，他还真没在意，实在是机要室的文件档案太多了，甚至每年都会销毁许多陈年档案。
“又是一年半……”
王杰没有翻看手中的档案，而是看向李皓，沉声道：“一次三年，一次两年，两次间隔一年半，1729年八九月份，是不是又发生了自焚案？”

1729年，也就是去年。
王杰回想了一下，去年发生过吗？
时间是间隔一年吗？
若是真有，那代表十年内，银城境内居然发生了六起自焚案了！
平摊下来其实真不多，两年一次，银城很大，还不是一个分部处理的，而是分散开，一个分部可能十年来也就接到一起，谁会在意？
李皓点头：“1729年又发生了一起，而且就在银城古院，而且……当事人就是我的同学，隔壁寝室！我离开银城古院，也有一部分原因和此事有关，当时我目睹了一切，对古院产生了恐惧害怕心理，加上我那同学自焚的诡异，所以我想知道，到底为什么会自焚！”
李皓面色凝重：“所以我来到巡检司，有一部分原因便是如此，外人无法查阅这些档案，我可以！我翻阅整理了最近十年来的自焚案，我发现……这也许并不是什么意外！”
王杰迅速翻看手中的文件，看了一会，看向李皓，沉声道：“说说你的想法。”
“十年，总共发生了六起，不，严格来说是九年，今年到现在还没接到这样的案子。”
李皓正色道：“室长，因为我同学的事，所以我很重视，眼看着已经七月份了，若是说，自焚案并非巧合，那现在间隔上一次自焚案，已经快一年了！这个自焚时间，是一次次在缩短的，如果不是意外，那很可能最近会出现类似案件。”
“不是意外吗？”
王杰一遍遍翻阅文件档案，他也是老巡检了，后来年纪稍微大了一点，这才调职到了机要室。
李皓要是不整理，不将几个案子单独整合到一起，恐怕真的没人会在意。
然而，当六起自焚案整合到了一起，任何人都能隐约察觉到一些不妥了。
王杰轻轻吐了口气：“单从现有的情况来看，并没有办法确定这是有预谋的，但是……太多的巧合，未必就是巧合！”
王杰还是很敏锐的，此刻迅速道：“此事我会向其他部门，尤其是执法队那边沟通，机要室并不直接参与破案，但是接连发生自焚，这恐怕需要重视一些，如果最近再发生……”
说到这，王杰面色微变：“那就代表，你判断的是正确的，可能真的不是意外那么简单了！”
他看向李皓，严肃的脸色忽然放松下来，露出笑容：“当然，也没必要太过紧张！就算是真的凶杀案，比这更恶劣的都有，倒是李皓你……做的不错！”
王杰的严肃，也只维持了不久。
别说还不确定，就算真的确定是凶杀，其实也没什么大不了的，他见的太多了，听的太多了，十年死了六个人，其实真不算什么。

他更欣慰，李皓对案件的执着和负责，当然，也大体上明白了一些李皓为何要退学的原因了。
好朋友吧！
否则，李皓也没必要退学了。
对面，李皓也不多说。
凶杀案？
若是真的凶杀，他何必退学，何必逃离银城古院。
亲眼目睹那一切，那是简单的凶杀反而好了。
那红色的血影到底是什么？
不，那是被血影焚烧而死的，可是当时和自己一样亲眼看到同学自焚的其他几位同学，居然无一人看到那血影！
是他们撒谎了吗？
不，没必要。
李皓知道，的确只有自己看到了，其他人根本就没发现血影，或者说，他们看不到。
而且，最近他又感受到了，甚至昨晚隐约又看到了那道血影。
也许……不是一道！
“没人注意就算了，一旦巡检司注意到了，确定不是意外，巡检司如果无法处理，那一定会上报到巡夜人那边。”
如果没人在意，那这些案子，只会当成意外结案，档案只会丢在机要室吃灰。
可若是被留心到了，巡检司还是相当负责的。
“巡夜人！”
李皓心中再次默念，对面，王杰起身道：“那我去找执法队商量一下，后续可能需要李皓你对接一下，提供一些帮助，毕竟这案子是你汇总的……”
李皓急忙点头，心中微微松了口气。

很好，听到了自己想要听的话。
他做这一切，就是为了参与其中，并非直接参与，而是作为意外发现者去参与，如此一来，若是巡夜人插手，那李皓很可能会在接下来接触到巡夜人。
当然，接触不代表可以加入，就算真能加入……李皓也未必敢加入！
这一年来，他看过的档案太多了。
有些事，字里行间都会体现出来，比如看到红影的事，好像并非自己一人可以看到，李皓查阅过一些资料档案，银城有过这样的记录。
然而，那些人，不是死了就是失踪了，无一幸免！
李皓没有说出这事，这其中有极大的危险，他甚至不敢告诉任何人，自己能看到红影，哪怕巡夜人，也未必就靠谱。
“不管如何……一定要通过一些正常途径，去接触这股神秘的力量！”
李皓深吸一口气，退出了办公室。
不单单是为了探查真相，关键是，为了自己的小命负责。
能看到红影的都死了，至于是否还有其他人能看到，李皓不知，可他知道，凡是暴露的都死了，这很不寻常。
“我这小命可不能轻易丢了，离开银城古院来到巡检司，可不是为了逃避。”
走出办公室的大门，李皓轻轻吐了口气，露出灿烂的笑容。
最好的结果，就是巡夜人解决这个麻烦，自己要是能有些意外收获那最好了，作为文职人员，如果能加入巡夜人的话，那李皓也希望能加入巡夜人当中的文职机构。
至于执法机构，李皓不觉得自己能胜任，而且也很危险，前些天去老师那边吃饭，李皓就旁敲侧击了一番，巡夜人……伤亡可不小！
“走一步看一步吧！”
李皓看着王杰匆匆离去，露出笑容，第一步总算是迈出去了。
“红影……”
心中默念，那玩意到底是什么东西？
而我能看到，又是因为什么？
content_en:
Opportunities need to be created by yourself.
The opportunity Li Hao needs also needs to be created by himself.
Soon, Li Hao organized a file in front of him, stood up, and walked towards the small office in the office area.
"Dong dong dong!"
Li Hao knocked on the office door.
The voice of the head of the confidential room came from the door: "Come in!"
Li Hao opened the office door.
"Chief!"
"Li Hao!"
The middle-aged Wang Jie couldn't help but smile when he saw Li Hao.
This is a good boy who is polite and willing to work. After all, he received higher education from Yincheng Ancient Academy. Although he dropped out of school early, he was not expelled but dropped out on his own. He was still very concerned about it.
Li Hao also smiled and said quickly: "Chief, I have something to report."
"Sit down!"
Wang Jie said hello. The tasks in the confidential room were not too heavy. As for things, it was nothing major. Major matters were usually carried out by the law enforcement team in front. Generally speaking, the confidential room was still very stable.
Regarding Li Hao's report, Wang Jie wondered if this guy wanted to look familiar so that he could promote him?
But the time was too short. This guy dropped out of school again and only became a full-time employee for half a year. It was impossible to be promoted in a short time.
Just as he was thinking about it, the face of Li Hao in front of him became serious, and his voice sounded a little dull: "Chief, I am in the confidential room, and I am mainly responsible for organizing the files of some suspicious and unsolved cases. After entering the confidential room for a year, I reorganized and reclassified some files from the past ten years..."
Wang Jie smiled instantly and nodded: "I know, top students are top students! The files used to be a bit messy, and some old files were almost eaten by insects. I also had people reorganize them, but they still can't be found when needed. As soon as you come here, you can find any cases you want to find recently. You have contributed to this..."
Li Hao shook his head quickly: "Chief, I'm not here to show off my merits."
Isn't it?
Wang Jie laughed. Could it be that he really had something to report?
He didn't say anything, nodded and motioned for Li Hao to continue.
Li Hao took out the document in front of him, handed one to Wang Jie, and opened one himself. Although he was young, his voice was calm: "On September 16, 1720, a self-immolation case occurred in Yincheng Anju Community. Someone witnessed the victim setting himself on fire in public. Sparks suddenly appeared from inside the body, burning the person alive."
Wang Jie also looked at the file in his hand at this moment, and then looked at Li Hao.
It was a case that happened ten years ago, and it has been closed. It was not a murder, but an accident. Why is this guy bringing up a case that was closed ten years ago?
Li Hao continued: "On September 22, 1723, in Yincheng Commercial Center, a salesperson's hair suddenly caught fire, and his whole body burned quickly. He was burned to death in public."
Wang Jie nodded, "I know this. I filed it in the first place. I even went to the scene in person. It was an accident. It was caused by excessive static electricity in the business center at that time."
Li Hao did not argue and continued to read: "On August 18, 1725, at the Yincheng Minsheng Hotel, a guest checked in and was found dead in the hotel a day later. He also burned himself to death."
There was a gap of five years between the first self-immolation case and two years between the second one.
In the past five years, three cases of self-immolation occurred, but they were all accidents. Yincheng had to deal with many cases every day. Three cases of self-immolation caused by accidents in five years were really not a big deal, and few people cared about it.
Unless by chance, all three cases are handled by one person, which might attract some attention.
There are countless files in the confidential room. Wang Jie usually didn't pay attention to them. Now after listening to a few words, he felt vaguely and looked at Li Hao with a frown.
Li Hao continued: "On February 16, 1727, another person burned himself to death on Dongfang Street in Yincheng. The reason was that ball lightning appeared nearby. It was suspected that ball lightning caused the human body to self-immolate.A self-immolation case, one and a half years later! "
Wang Jie's expression changed slightly. From three years to two years, from two years to one and a half years, another self-immolation case occurred in Yincheng!
"In 1728, on August 12, the Yincheng Suburban Inspection Department reported that a person was missing in the territory. Later, a burned corpse was found by the river. It was suspected that it was caused by lightning during a thunderstorm, and the case was closed accidentally. "
Another year and a half!
This was reported by a subordinate agency. The confidential office only organizes files and does not participate in case processing. Moreover, cases caused by such accidents have been closed below and will not be overturned rashly by the superiors.
Wang Jie's face became more and more solemn. He really didn't care. There were too many documents and files in the confidential room, and many old files were even destroyed every year.
"Another year and a half..."
Wang Jie did not look through the file in his hand, but looked at Li Hao and said in a deep voice: "Once it was three years, once it was two years, and there was a year and a half interval between the two times. In August and September of 1729, was there another self-immolation case? "
1729, that is, last year.
Wang Jie thought about it, did it happen last year?
Is it a year apart?
If this is true, it means that within ten years, there have been six self-immolations in Yincheng!
It's actually not much when divided evenly. It's once every two years. Yincheng is so big that it's not handled by one branch, but scattered. One branch may only handle it together in ten years. Who cares?
Li Hao nodded: "Another incident happened in 1729, and it happened in Yincheng Ancient Courtyard, and... the person involved was my classmate, in the next door dormitory! Part of the reason why I left Yincheng Ancient Courtyard was related to this incident. I witnessed everything at that time and developed a fear of the Ancient Courtyard. In addition, my classmate's self-immolation was weird, so I wanted to know why he burned himself! "
Li Hao looked solemn: "That's part of the reason why I came to the Inspection Department. Outsiders can't check these files, but I can! I looked through and sorted through the self-immolation cases in the past ten years, and I found... maybe this is not an accident! "
Wang Jie quickly looked through the documents in his hand, looked at them for a while, looked at Li Hao, and said in a deep voice: "Tell me what you think. "
“In ten years, a total of six cases have occurred, no, strictly speaking, it is nine years, and we have not received such a case so far this year. "
Li Hao said sternly: "Director, because of my classmate's incident, I take it very seriously. It's already July. If the self-immolation case is not a coincidence, then it has been almost a year since the last self-immolation case! The time for self-immolation is shortening time after time. If it were not an accident, it is likely that similar cases will appear in the near future. "
"Isn't it an accident? "
Wang Jie looked through the documents and files over and over again. He was also an old patrol inspector. Later, when he got a little older, he was transferred to the confidential room.
If Li Hao doesn't sort it out and integrate several cases individually, I'm afraid no one will really care.
However, when the six cases of self-immolation were put together, anyone could vaguely sense that something was wrong.
Wang Jie breathed out softly: "Based on the current situation, there is no way to confirm that this was premeditated, but... too many coincidences may not be coincidences! "
Wang Jie was still very perceptive and said quickly at this moment: "I will communicate this matter to other departments, especially the law enforcement team. The confidential office is not directly involved in solving the case, but self-immolations have occurred one after another. I am afraid this needs to be paid more attention to. If it happens again recently..."
Speaking of this, Wang Jie's expression changed slightly: "That means that your judgment is correct, and it may not be as simple as an accident! "
He looked at Li Hao, his serious face suddenly relaxed and smiled: "Of course, there is no need to be too nervous! Even if it's a real murder, there are worse cases than this, but Li Hao... you did a good job! "
Wang Jie's seriousness only lasted for a short time.
Don't say you're not sure yet, even if it's really confirmed to be murder,In fact, it's not a big deal. He has seen too much and heard too much. Six people died in ten years, but it's really nothing.
He was even more pleased with Li Hao's persistence and responsibility for the case. Of course, he also generally understood some of the reasons why Li Hao dropped out of school.
Be good friends!
Otherwise, there is no need for Li Hao to drop out of school.
On the opposite side, Li Hao didn't say much.
Homicide?
If it was really a murder, why would he drop out of school or escape from Yincheng Ancient Courtyard.
Seeing it all with my own eyes, it was a simple murder but better.
What is that red blood shadow?
No, he was burned to death by the blood shadow. But at that time, like him, the other classmates who saw their classmates self-immolate with their own eyes, none of them saw the blood shadow!
Did they lie?
No, it's not necessary.
Li Hao knew that he was the only one who saw it, and others did not notice the blood shadow at all, or in other words, they could not see it.
Moreover, he felt it again recently, and even vaguely saw the blood shadow last night.
Maybe... not the same thing!
"Forget it if no one notices it. Once the inspection department notices it, it will be sure that it is not an accident. If the inspection department cannot handle it, it will definitely be reported to the night watchman."
If no one cares, these cases will just be closed as accidents, and the files will just be left in the confidential room to collect dust.
But if someone notices it, the inspection department is still quite responsible.
"Night watchman!"
Li Hao thought silently in his heart again. On the opposite side, Wang Jie stood up and said: "Then I will go to the law enforcement team to discuss it. I may need Li Hao to contact you and provide some help in the future. After all, you compiled this case..."
Li Hao nodded hurriedly, feeling slightly relieved.
Great, I heard what I wanted to hear.
He did all this just to participate, not directly, but as an unexpected discoverer. In this way, if the night watchman intervenes, Li Hao is likely to come into contact with the night watchman next.
Of course, contact does not mean that you can join. Even if you can join... Li Hao may not dare to join!
This year, he has seen too many files.
Some things are reflected between the lines. For example, when he saw the red shadow, it seemed that he was not the only one to see it. Li Hao had checked some files and found that Yincheng had such a record.
However, those people were either dead or missing, no one was spared!
Li Hao didn't tell anyone about this. There was great danger involved. He didn't even dare to tell anyone that he could see the red shadow. Even the night watchman might not be reliable.
"No matter what...you must contact this mysterious power through some normal channels!"
Li Hao took a deep breath and exited the office.
Not only to find out the truth, but more importantly, to take responsibility for your own life.
Everyone who could see the red shadow was dead. As for whether anyone else could see it, Li Hao didn't know, but he knew that everyone who was exposed died, which was very unusual.
"I can't lose my life so easily. I didn't leave Yincheng Ancient Courtyard to come to the Inspection Department just to escape."
Walking out of the office door, Li Hao breathed out softly and showed a bright smile.
The best result is for the night watchman to solve this problem. It would be best if he can get some unexpected gains. As a civilian, if he can join the night watchman, Li Hao also hopes to join the civilian organization among the night watchman.
As for the law enforcement agency, Li Hao didn't think he was competent, and it was also very dangerous. When he went to the teacher's place for dinner a few days ago, Li Hao made some insinuations. The night watchman... the casualties were not small!
"Take a step and see what happens!"
Li Hao watched Wang Jie leave in a hurry, smiled, and finally took the first step.
"Hongying..."
I thought to myself, what on earth is that thing?
And I can see it, why?
